operator_instruction: Create and execute a serialized final-integration window
problem_statement: The existing global integration lane was acquired only after expensive required Python checks completed, so otherwise-green assurance could be invalidated by a main-head advance discovered at final readiness.

correction.profile_admission_handshake: OVC profile assurance waits for the exact-head OVC merge readiness holder, independently rechecks current main, then proves PR-head ancestry before checkout/test selection proceeds.
correction.required_check_admission_handshake: tests workflow waits for the exact-head OVC merge readiness holder, independently rechecks current main, then proves PR-head ancestry before canonical Python jobs proceed.

adversarial_correction_evidence.finding: Status-only admission allowed profile assurance to start despite the readiness acquisition step failing on stale main.
adversarial_correction_evidence.repair: Both profile and canonical-required admission paths now independently recheck current main and candidate ancestry before expensive assurance.

acceptance_conditions: Only the existing tests.yml and ovc-tiered-tests.yml pull-request workflows remain.
Only one PR can hold the repository-wide final-integration window at a time and queued windows are not cancelled.
The existing global integration-lane identity is reused so in-flight older readiness jobs and the corrective window cannot execute concurrently.
OVC profile assurance and the canonical required Python jobs independently verify current-main freshness and candidate ancestry before expensive assurance begins.
A stale event base or a candidate that does not contain the admitted current-main commit fails before final assurance starts.
Any main movement while the final-integration window is held fails closed with the existing readiness movement guard class.
The complete repository suite remains present exactly once and no required-check semantics are weakened.
rollback: Revert only the final-integration admission handshakes and expanded hold semantics, restoring the prior PDC v1 readiness-lane timing while preserving the lane identity, all historical evidence and the fail-closed stable-main guard.

required: OVC merge readiness on the same exact head
